items.headline: Round of 32 Conclusion
items.body: The Round of 32 concludes today, July 3, 2026, with the final three matches determining the last spots in the Round of 16. The tournament has already seen major exits, including Germany, Croatia, and Austria, while teams like France, Brazil, and the United States have secured their progression.

items.headline: Australia vs Egypt
items.body: Australia faces Egypt at AT&T Stadium in Arlington, Texas. Both teams are seeking their first-ever knockout stage victory in the tournament.

items.headline: Argentina vs Cabo Verde
items.body: Defending champions Argentina take on tournament surprise Cabo Verde at Miami Stadium. Lionel Messi leads the Argentine side as they look to advance.

items.headline: Colombia vs Ghana
items.body: Unbeaten Colombia meets Ghana at Kansas City Stadium. Colombia topped Group K and aims to continue their strong form in the knockout phase.

items.headline: Germany Squad Rebuild
items.body: Following their elimination by Paraguay, reports indicate Germany is preparing for a major squad overhaul. Veterans including Manuel Neuer and Thomas Müller are expected to have played their final international matches.

items.headline: Lionel Messi Golden Boot Race
items.body: Lionel Messi enters today's match against Cabo Verde with six goals in the tournament. He remains a primary contender for the Golden Boot award.
